from fastapi import FastAPI, Depends, HTTPException, status
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware
from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse
from fastapi.exceptions import RequestValidationError
from loguru import logger

from app.core.config import settings
from app.core.logging_config import setup_logging
from app.core.middlewares import exception_handling_middleware, log_request_middleware
from app.core.exceptions import HTTPUnauthorizedException, HTTPForbiddenException, HTTPNotFoundException, HTTPConflictException
from app.api.v1.api import api_router

# Setup logging as early as possible
setup_logging()

logger.info("Starting FastAPI application...")

app = FastAPI(
    title=settings.PROJECT_NAME,
    openapi_url=f"{settings.API_V1_STR}/openapi.json",
    docs_url=f"{settings.API_V1_STR}/docs",
    redoc_url=f"{settings.API_V1_STR}/redoc",
)

# Add CORS middleware
app.add_middleware(
    CORSMiddleware,
    allow_origins=[str(origin) for origin in settings.BACKEND_CORS_ORIGINS],
    allow_credentials=True,
    allow_methods=["*"],
    allow_headers=["*"],
)

# Add custom middlewares
app.middleware("http")(exception_handling_middleware)
app.middleware("http")(log_request_middleware)

# Include API routers
app.include_router(api_router, prefix=settings.API_V1_STR)

# Custom exception handlers for FastAPI's default HTTPExceptions and Pydantic validation errors
@app.exception_handler(HTTPException)
async def http_exception_handler(request, exc):
    logger.error(f"HTTPException caught: {exc.status_code} - {exc.detail}",
                 extra={"request_url": str(request.url), "method": request.method})
    return JSONResponse(
        status_code=exc.status_code,
        content={"detail": exc.detail},
    )

@app.exception_handler(RequestValidationError)
async def validation_exception_handler(request, exc):
    logger.error(f"Request validation error: {exc.errors()}",
                 extra={"request_url": str(request.url), "method": request.method, "errors": exc.errors()})
    return JSONResponse(
        status_code=status.HTTP_422_UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,
        content={"detail": exc.errors()},
    )

@app.get("/")
async def root():
    logger.info("Root endpoint accessed.")
    return {"message": "Welcome to SODA OMEGA PILOT Inventory Management API"}

logger.info("FastAPI application initialized.")

from datetime import timedelta
from typing import Any

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, status
from fastapi.security import OAuth2PasswordRequestForm
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
from loguru import logger

from app.core.config import settings
from app.core import security
from app.core.exceptions import HTTPUnauthorizedException, HTTPConflictException
from app.db.database import get_db
from app.db import crud
from app.db import schemas

router = APIRouter()

@router.post("/register", response_model=schemas.UserResponse, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
async def register_user(
    user_in: schemas.UserCreate,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db)
) -> Any:
    """
    Register a new user.
    """
    logger.info(f"Attempting to register new user: {user_in.username}")
    user = crud.user.get_user_by_username(db, username=user_in.username)
    if user:
        logger.warning(f"Registration failed: Username '{user_in.username}' already exists.")
        raise HTTPConflictException(detail="Username already registered")
    
    user = crud.user.create_user(db, user_in)
    crud.audit.create_audit_log(db, user_id=user.id, action="REGISTER", entity_type="User", entity_id=user.id, details={"username": user.username})
    logger.info(f"User '{user.username}' registered successfully.")
    return user

@router.post("/login", response_model=schemas.Token)
async def login_for_access_token(
    form_data: OAuth2PasswordRequestForm = Depends(),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db)
) -> Any:
    """
    OAuth2 compatible token login, get an access token for future requests.
    """
    logger.info(f"Attempting login for user: {form_data.username}")
    user = crud.user.authenticate_user(db, username=form_data.username, password=form_data.password)
    if not user:
        logger.warning(f"Login failed: Invalid credentials for user '{form_data.username}'.")
        raise HTTPUnauthorizedException(detail="Incorrect username or password")
    
    access_token_expires = timedelta(minutes=settings.ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES)
    refresh_token_expires = timedelta(days=settings.REFRESH_TOKEN_EXPIRE_DAYS)
    
    access_token = security.create_access_token(
        data={"sub": user.username, "user_id": user.id}, expires_delta=access_token_expires
    )
    refresh_token = security.create_refresh_token(
        data={"sub": user.username, "user_id": user.id}, expires_delta=refresh_token_expires
    )
    
    crud.audit.create_audit_log(db, user_id=user.id, action="LOGIN", entity_type="User", entity_id=user.id, details={"username": user.username})
    logger.info(f"User '{user.username}' logged in successfully.")
    return {
        "access_token": access_token,
        "refresh_token": refresh_token,
        "token_type": "bearer",
    }

@router.post("/refresh", response_model=schemas.Token)
async def refresh_access_token(
    refresh_token: str,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db)
) -> Any:
    """
    Refresh access token using a valid refresh token.
    """
    logger.info("Attempting to refresh access token.")
    credentials_exception = HTTPUnauthorizedException(detail="Could not validate credentials")
    try:
        payload = security.verify_token(refresh_token, token_type="refresh")
        username: str = payload.get("sub")
        user_id: int = payload.get("user_id")
        if username is None or user_id is None:
            logger.warning("Refresh token payload missing username or user_id.")
            raise credentials_exception
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Refresh token verification failed: {e}")
        raise credentials_exception
    
    user = crud.user.get_user_by_id(db, user_id=user_id)
    if user is None:
        logger.warning(f"Refresh token user_id '{user_id}' not found.")
        raise credentials_exception

    access_token_expires = timedelta(minutes=settings.ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES)
    new_access_token = security.create_access_token(
        data={"sub": user.username, "user_id": user.id}, expires_delta=access_token_expires
    )
    
    # Optionally, rotate refresh token as well
    refresh_token_expires = timedelta(days=settings.REFRESH_TOKEN_EXPIRE_DAYS)
    new_refresh_token = security.create_refresh_token(
        data={"sub": user.username, "user_id": user.id}, expires_delta=refresh_token_expires
    )

    crud.audit.create_audit_log(db, user_id=user.id, action="TOKEN_REFRESH", entity_type="User", entity_id=user.id, details={"username": user.username})
    logger.info(f"Access token refreshed for user '{user.username}'.")
    return {
        "access_token": new_access_token,
        "refresh_token": new_refresh_token,
        "token_type": "bearer",
    }

@router.get("/me", response_model=schemas.UserResponse)
async def read_users_me(
    current_user: schemas.User = Depends(security.get_current_active_user)
) -> Any:
    """
    Get current authenticated user.
    """
    logger.info(f"User '{current_user.username}' accessed /me endpoint.")
    return current_user

@router.post("/logout", status_code=status.HTTP_200_OK)
async def logout(
    current_user: schemas.User = Depends(security.get_current_active_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db)
) -> Any:
    """
    Logs out the current user by invalidating their tokens (client-side).
    For a robust logout, a token blacklist or revocation mechanism would be needed.
    This endpoint primarily signals to the client to clear their tokens.
    """
    crud.audit.create_audit_log(db, user_id=current_user.id, action="LOGOUT", entity_type="User", entity_id=current_user.id, details={"username": current_user.username})
    logger.info(f"User '{current_user.username}' logged out (client-side token clear advised).")
    return {"message": "Logged out successfully. Please clear tokens on client side."}

from typing import List, Any

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, status, HTTPException
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
from loguru import logger

from app.db.database import get_db
from app.db import crud, schemas, models
from app.core import security
from app.core.exceptions import HTTPNotFoundException, HTTPConflictException, HTTPForbiddenException

router = APIRouter()

# --- Category Endpoints ---
@router.post("/categories/", response_model=schemas.CategoryResponse, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
async def create_category(
    category_in: schemas.CategoryCreate,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    current_user: models.User = Depends(security.get_current_active_user)
) -> Any:
    """
    Create a new inventory category.
    """
    logger.info(f"User {current_user.username} (ID: {current_user.id}) attempting to create category: {category_in.name}")
    existing_category = crud.inventory.get_category_by_name(db, name=category_in.name)
    if existing_category:
        logger.warning(f"Category creation failed: Category '{category_in.name}' already exists.")
        raise HTTPConflictException(detail="Category with this name already exists")
    
    category = crud.inventory.create_category(db, category_in)
    crud.audit.create_audit_log(db, user_id=current_user.id, action="CREATE", entity_type="Category", entity_id=category.id, details={"name": category.name})
    logger.info(f"Category '{category.name}' (ID: {category.id}) created by user {current_user.username}.")
    return category

@router.get("/categories/", response_model=List[schemas.CategoryResponse])
async def read_categories(
    skip: int = 0,
    limit: int = 100,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    current_user: models.User = Depends(security.get_current_active_user)
) -> Any:
    """
    Retrieve multiple inventory categories.
    """
    logger.info(f"User {current_user.username} (ID: {current_user.id}) retrieving categories (skip: {skip}, limit: {limit}).")
    categories = crud.inventory.get_categories(db, skip=skip, limit=limit)
    return categories

@router.get("/categories/{category_id}", response_model=schemas.CategoryResponse)
async def read_category(
    category_id: int,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    current_user: models.User = Depends(security.get_current_active_user)
) -> Any:
    """
    Retrieve a single inventory category by ID.
    """
    logger.info(f"User {current_user.username} (ID: {current_user.id}) retrieving category ID: {category_id}.")
    category = crud.inventory.get_category(db, category_id)
    if not category:
        logger.warning(f"Category ID {category_id} not found.")
        raise HTTPNotFoundException(detail="Category not found")
    return category

@router.put("/categories/{category_id}", response_model=schemas.CategoryResponse)
async def update_category(
    category_id: int,
    category_in: schemas.CategoryUpdate,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    current_user: models.User = Depends(security.get_current_active_user)
) -> Any:
    """
    Update an existing inventory category.
    """
    logger.info(f"User {current_user.username} (ID: {current_user.id}) attempting to update category ID: {category_id}.")
    category = crud.inventory.get_category(db, category_id)
    if not category:
        logger.warning(f"Category update failed: Category ID {category_id} not found.")
        raise HTTPNotFoundException(detail="Category not found")
    
    if category_in.name and crud.inventory.get_category_by_name(db, name=category_in.name) and crud.inventory.get_category_by_name(db, name=category_in.name).id != category_id:
        logger.warning(f"Category update failed: Category name '{category_in.name}' already exists for another category.")
        raise HTTPConflictException(detail="Category with this name already exists")
    
    updated_category = crud.inventory.update_category(db, db_obj=category, obj_in=category_in)
    crud.audit.create_audit_log(db, user_id=current_user.id, action="UPDATE", entity_type="Category", entity_id=category.id, details={"old_name": category.name, "new_name": updated_category.name})
    logger.info(f"Category '{updated_category.name}' (ID: {updated_category.id}) updated by user {current_user.username}.")
    return updated_category

@router.delete("/categories/{category_id}", status_code=status.HTTP_204_NO_CONTENT)
async def delete_category(
    category_id: int,
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    current_user: models.User = Depends(security.get_current_active_user)
) -> None:
    """
    Delete an inventory category.
    """
    logger.info(f"User {current_user.username} (ID: {current_user.id}) attempting to delete category ID: {category_id}.")
    category = crud.inventory.get_category(db, category_id)
    if not category:
        logger.warning(f"Category deletion failed: Category ID {category_id} not found.")
        raise HTTPNotFoundException(detail="Category not found")
    
    # Check if there are any items associated with this category
    items_in_category = crud.inventory.get_inventory_items_by_category(db, category_id=category_id)
    if items_in_category:
        logger.warning(f"Category deletion failed: Category ID {category_id} has associated inventory items.")
        raise HTTPConflictException(detail="Cannot delete category with associated inventory items. Please reassign or delete items first.")
    
    crud.inventory.delete_category(db, category_id)
    crud.audit.create_audit_log(db, user_id=current_user.id, action="DELETE", entity_type="Category", entity_id=category_id, details={"name": category.name})
    logger.info(f"Category ID {category_id} deleted by user {current_user.username}.")
    return None

) -> Any:

    return location

    return updated_location
